    Biserial projectives in element form #

    BisAt i says that R e_i = A u₁ + A u₂ with A u_t uniserial (LChain) and u_t = e_{s_t} u_t. It gives the chain property for every arrow starting at i (lchain_of_bisAt) and at most two arrows starting at i (out_of_bisAt).
